title: A Asset for the Deadline
author: Theo Amberdale
blurb: Coral Marchetti, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. But when the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
